about.what: Facts made wrong on purpose, to measure what the fact judge catches. Written by Fable on 2026-11-12 against the transcripts of lectures 1, 4 and 16.
about.how: Test one entry per judge call. Take the segment's 2a facts, remove the facts named in 'replaces' (if any), put the entry's 'facts' in their place (or at the end when nothing is replaced), renumber, and judge. Every fact in 'facts' should fail. Segments 1/S4 and 16/S4 have no 2a facts: the seeded fact is then the only one.
about.fields: breaks: the property the error breaks (1 Significant, 2 Whole, 3 Established, 4 Grounded, 5 Self-contained, 6 Terms in full, 7 On the subject, 8 Faithful); when several are listed, a failure on any of them counts as caught for the right reason. kind: the error. code: true when the code checks of fact_checks.py should also catch it.
about.scoring: Caught: the judge fails the seeded fact. Caught for the right reason: its reason names a property in 'breaks'. Also record every other fact of the call that the judge fails: with one seeded fact per call, those are comparable with the baseline round.
